title: Constant scalars and comparison commute with scheme inverse image
statement: For schemes X and Y and a morphism f : Y → X, and any commutative ring A in the independent coefficient universe, the canonical intrinsic-module comparison inverse image on X followed by constant-scalar restriction and pro-etale inverse image along f is naturally isomorphic to constant-scalar restriction on X followed by etale inverse image along f and fixed-scalar comparison inverse image on Y. All sites and functors are the recorded coefficient-sized models [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data], [def-pe-etale-constructible-module], and [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. No constructibility or Noetherianity hypothesis is used.

proof.text: The constant-ring unit is locally bijective. Scalar restriction is fully faithful by the Mathlib locally-surjective scalar-restriction Hom equivalence. To construct an antecedent of a fixed-scalar sheaf, apply module sheafification to the identity of its underlying abelian sheaf. The sheafification unit extends the scalar action; identity maps give its inverse isomorphism. Thus the literal coefficientModelFixedScalars functor is an equivalence.

The ring-map adjunction equation states that constructibleComparisonRingMap sends each constant scalar to the same constant scalar. This identifies module direct image followed by scalar restriction with scalar restriction followed by fixed-scalar comparison direct image, by identity linear maps on sections. Conjugate through the two scalar equivalences and use uniqueness of left adjoints to identify the two comparison inverse images.

On site objects comparison and scheme base change commute: both are the same fibre product. Whisker the original site natural isomorphism by AsSmall.down and AsSmall.up. Its isomorphism on continuous direct images identifies the right adjoints of the two inverse-image composites. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives their inverse-image isomorphism. Whisker and compose it with the scalar comparison of the preceding step.

theorem coefficientComparison_fixedPullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] :
    Nonempty
      (constructibleComparisonPullback.{u, v} X A ⋙
          coefficientModelFixedScalars (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A ⋙
          Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} f A ≅
        coefficientModelFixedScalars (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A ⋙
          Scheme.coefficientEtaleFixedPullback.{u, v} f A ⋙
          Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
            (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} Y) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
            (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} Y)
            (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y))
